api_timeout_secs.description: HTTP timeout for V2Board API calls.

error_body_limit_bytes.description: Maximum panel error body bytes retained in errors/logs.

geosite.description: Local plain-text rule files for V2Board geosite: route matchers, one matcher per line (bare keyword, keyword:, domain:, full:, or regexp:).

geoip.description: Local plain-text rule files for V2Board geoip: route matchers, one IP/CIDR per line.

node_type.description: V2Board node type. Aliases ss, v2ray, hysteria2, and naive are normalized to shadowsocks, vmess, hysteria, and naiveproxy for UniProxy.

listen.description: Local listen IP. The port comes from the panel node config.

pull_interval_secs.description: Optional per-node config/user pull interval override.

push_interval_secs.description: Optional per-node traffic/alive push interval override.

tls.description: Optional per-node TLS certificate files. Overrides top-level tls.

trojan_fallback.description: Optional host:port direct decoy destination for Trojan nodes. Must use a different port from the node listener.

hysteria2_masquerade.description: Optional static HTTP/3 response for Hysteria2 ordinary and failed-auth requests; not a reverse proxy.

node_report_min_traffic.description: Fallback minimum bytes before user traffic is pushed.

device_online_min_traffic.description: Fallback minimum bytes before alive IPs are pushed.

max_legacy_shadowsocks_users.description: Startup guard for O(n) legacy Shadowsocks multi-user authentication.

tcp_fast_open.description: Parsed but not wired in the V2Board runtime yet.

file.description: Optional log file path. The CLI -l/--log-file can add destinations.

outbounds.description: Optional local outbounds for node-side routing. Credentials live in this local file; keep it private (chmod 0600).

default_out.description: Fallback outbound tag used when no route rule matches. Must be a configured outbound tag; absent means direct (today's behavior).

route_rules.description: CRS one-liners (DOMAIN-SUFFIX/DOMAIN/DOMAIN-KEYWORD/DOMAIN-REGEX/IP-CIDR/IP-CIDR6/GEOSITE/GEOIP/PROTOCOL/MATCH). Matched in order, first match wins; MATCH is the explicit catch-all.

rule_providers.description: External CRS rule files, hot-reloaded by mtime.

tag.description: Unique outbound tag referenced by route rules, default_out, and chains.

chain.description: Chain of outbound tags to forward through. When present, type/server and credentials are ignored. Hops must exist; cycles are rejected.

type.description: Protocol type. Aliases socks5, ss, naive, and ws/websocket match the client protocol stack names. ws/websocket alone is rejected (use transport: {type: ws} with a proxy type).

password.description: Required for trojan, anytls, ss, snell, and naiveproxy. For shadowtls it is both the ShadowTLS secret and the inner Shadowsocks password.

cipher.description: Required for ss, snell, and shadowtls (inner Shadowsocks cipher); required for vmess.

username.description: Optional for http/socks; required for naiveproxy.

udp.description: Enable UDP forwarding where the protocol supports it.

enabled.description: Default is inferred: trojan/anytls/naiveproxy imply TLS; vless/vmess need an explicit true.

sni.description: TLS SNI hostname; defaults to the server hostname.

cert_file.description: Readable PEM file with the private CA that signs the upstream server certificate; its contents are embedded in the client TLS config. Checked by validate.

alpn.description: TLS ALPN protocols, e.g. h2, http/1.1.

short_id.description: REALITY short id (hex, up to 16 chars); defaults to all zeros.

type.description: WebSocket is supported; grpc/httpupgrade/xhttp are rejected by validate for now.

host.description: Host header sent by the WebSocket client.

tag.description: Unique provider tag used in diagnostics.

path.description: File containing CRS one-liners, one per line. Must exist and parse; checked by validate.

reload_interval_secs.description: mtime poll interval for hot reload.

status_code.description: HTTP/3 status code; informational and body-forbidden statuses are rejected.
